<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="Amire80" /></noinclude><section begin=par85 />{{GHGmargin-letter|85|i}}
(''c'') Ground-form ''măqṭĭl'', Hebr. {{GHGheb|text=מַקְטֵל}}, e.g. {{GHGheb|text=מַשְׁעֵן|translate=a support}} (fem. {{GHGheb|text=מַשְׁעֵנָה}}), {{GHGheb|text=מַסְגֵּר|translate=a smith}}, {{GHGheb|text=מַֽעֲשֵׂר|translate=a tithe}}; fem. {{GHGheb|text=מַכְשֵׁלָה|translate=a ruin}}; from a verb {{GHGheb|text=פ״ן}}, {{GHGheb|text=מַגֵּפָה|translate=an overthrow}}, {{GHGheb|text=מַצֵּבָה|translate=a pillar}}; from verbs {{GHGheb|text=ע״ע}}, {{GHGheb|text=מָגֵן|translate=a shield}}; fem. {{GHGheb|text=מְגִלָּה|translate=a roll}} (from {{GHGheb|text=גָּלַל}}), {{GHGheb|text=מְאֵרָה|translate=a curse}} (for ''m<sup>e</sup>’irrā'' from {{GHGheb|text=אָרַר}}); from a verb {{GHGheb|text=פ״ו}}, {{GHGheb|text=מוֹקֵשׁ|translate=a snare}} (from ''măwqĭš'').

{{GHGmargin-letter|85|k}}
(''d'') Ground-form ''mĭqṭĭl'', Hebr. {{GHGheb|text=מִקְטֵל}}, e.g. {{GHGheb|text=מִסְפֵּד|translate=mourning}}, {{GHGheb|text=מִוְבֵּחַ|translate=an altar}} (''place of sacrifice''); from a verb {{GHGheb|text=ע״ע}}, e.g. {{GHGheb|text=מֵסֵב}} ({{GHGheb|text=מֵסַב}}?) ''consessus''; (''e'') ground-from ''măqṭŭl'', Hebr. {{GHGheb|text=מַקְטֹל}}; fem. {{GHGheb|text=מַֽאֲכֹ֫לֶת|translate=food}}, {{GHGheb|text=מַשְׂכֹּ֫רֶת|translate=wages}}; from a verb {{GHGheb|text=ע״ע}}, fem. {{GHGheb|text=מְסֻכָּה|translate=a covering}} (from {{GHGheb|text=סָכַךְ}}). Also from {{GHGheb|text=ע״ע}}, according to the Masora, {{GHGheb|text=מָעוֹז|translate=a refuge}}, with suffixes {{GHGheb|text=מָֽעֻוִּי}} and {{GHGheb|text=מָֽעוּזִּי}}, plur. {{GHGheb|text=מָֽעֻזִּים}}, but, very probably, most if not all of these forms are to be referred to the stem {{GHGheb|text=עוּז|translate=to flee for safety}}, and therefore should be written {{GHGheb|text=מְעוֹזִי}}, &c. The form {{GHGheb|text=מָעֹז}}, if derived from the stem {{GHGheb|text=עזז}}, would mean ''stronghold''.—Cf. also {{GHGheb|text=מֹ֫רֶךְ|translate=faintness}}, developed to a segholate, probably from {{GHGheb|text=מְרֹךְ}}, for ''mărōkh'' from {{GHGheb|text=רָכַךְ}}, like {{GHGheb|text=מְתֹם|translate=soundness}} of body, from {{GHGheb|text=תָּמַם}}.

{{GHGmargin-letter|85|l}}
With a long vowel in the second syllable: (''f'') ground-form ''maqṭâl'', with ''â'' always obscured to ''ô'', e.g. {{GHGheb|text=מַחְסוֹר|translate=want}}, {{GHGheb|text=מַלְקוֹחַ|translate=booty}}; from verbs {{GHGheb|text=ע״וּ}}, e.g. {{GHGheb|text=מָגוֹר|translate=fear}}, fem. {{GHGheb|text=מְגוֹרָה}} and {{GHGheb|text=מְגוּרָה}} (with the ''ô'' depressed to ''û'' in a toneless syllable; cf. {{GHGpar|27|n}}), {{GHGheb|text=מְהוּמָה}}, &c., {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=22|verse=5}}. (''g'') Ground-form ''mĭqṭâl'', in Hebr. again {{GHGheb|text=מִקְטוֹל}}, e.g. {{GHGheb|text=מִסְתּוֹר|translate=a covert}}, {{GHGheb|text=מִכְשׁוֹל|translate=a stumbling-block}} (cf. above under i, ''măkhšēlā''); fem. {{GHGheb|text=מִכְמֹ֫רֶת|translate=a fishing-net}}; (''h'') the ground-forms ''maqṭîl'', ''miqṭîl'' (cf. {{GHGheb|text=מֵקִים}}) are found only in participles {{GHGterm|Hiphʿîl}}; the fem. {{GHGheb|text=מַבְלִיגִית}}, ''cheerfulness'', is a denominative formed from a participle {{GHGterm|Hiphʿîl}}; (''i'') ground-form ''măqṭûl'', as {{GHGheb|text=מַלְבּוּשׁ|translate=a garment}}.

{{GHGmargin-letter|85|m}}
Rem. On {{GHGheb|text=מ‍}} as preformative of the participles of all the conjugations except {{GHGterm|Qal}} and {{GHGterm|Niphʿal}}, cf. {{GHGpar|52|c}}. Many of these participles have become substantives, as {{GHGheb|text=מְזַמֶּ֫רֶת|translate=snuffers}}, {{GHGheb|text=מַשְׁחִית|translate=destroyer, destruction}}.

{{GHGmargin-letter|85|n}}
49. Nouns with {{GHGheb|text=נ‍}} prefixed. Besides the participles {{GHGterm|Niphʿal}} (ground-form ''năqṭăl'', still retained e.g. in {{GHGheb|text=נוֹלָד}} for ''năwlād'', but commonly attenuated to ''nıqṭăl'', Hebr. {{GHGheb|text=נִקְטָל}}) and the infinitive {{GHGterm|Niphʿal}} of the form {{GHGheb|text=נִקְטֹל}}, the prefix {{GHGheb|text=נ‍}} is found in {{GHGheb|text=נַפְתּוּלִים|translate=wrestlings}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=30|verse=8}}, which is also to be referred to {{GHGterm|Niphʿal}}, and {{GHGheb|text=נָזִיד|translate=boiled pottage}} (stem {{GHGheb|text=זיד}}).

{{GHGmargin-letter|85|o}}
50. With {{GHGheb|text=שׁ}} prefixed, e.g. {{GHGheb|text=שַׁלְהֶ֫בֶת|translate=a flame}}. On this ''Šaph‛ēl'' formation, cf. {{GHGpar|55|i}}.

{{GHGmargin-letter|85|p}}
51. Nouns with {{GHGheb|text=ת}} prefixed. Examples of this formation are numerous, especially from weak stems, for the purpose of strengthening them phonetically (see Barth, ''ibid.'', p. 283), and notably from verbs {{GHGheb|text=פ״ו}} and {{GHGheb|text=ע״וּ}}. They may be classified as follows:—(''a'') the ground-form ''tăqṭăl'' in {{GHGheb|text=תַּחְמָס|translate=ostrich}} (?); from verbs {{GHGheb|text=פ״ו}}, {{GHGheb|text=תּוֹשָׁב|translate=a settler}}; fem. {{GHGheb|text=תּוֹחֶ֫לֶת|translate=expectation}}, {{GHGheb|text=תּוֹכַ֫חַת}} (from the {{GHGterm|Hiphʿîl}} {{GHGheb|text=הוֹכִיתַ}}) ''correction''; from a verb {{GHGheb|text=פ״י}}, {{GHGheb|text=תֵּימָן|translate=the south}}; from verbs {{GHGheb|text=פ״ו}} and {{GHGheb|text=ל״ה}}, {{GHGheb|text=תּוֹדָה|translate=thanksgiving}}, and {{GHGheb|text=תּוֹרָה|translate=law}}, both from {{GHGterm|Hiphʿîl}}; from a verb {{GHGheb|text=פ״ו}} and {{GHGheb|text=ל״א}}, {{GHGheb|text=תּֽוֹצָאוֹת|translate=issues}}; probably belonging to this class, from verbs {{GHGheb|text=ע״ע}}, {{GHGheb|text=תֶּ֫בֶל|translate=confusion}}, and {{GHGheb|text=תֶּ֫מֶס|translate=a melting away}} (developed from {{GHGheb|text=תְּבַל}} and {{GHGheb|text=תְּמַס}}, from {{GHGheb|text=בָּלַל}} and {{GHGheb|text=מָסַס}}).

{{GHGmargin-letter|85|q}}
(''b'') ''Tĭqṭăl'', e.g. fem. {{GHGheb|text=תִּפְאָרָה}} and {{GHGheb|text=תִּפְאֶ֫רֶת|translate=glory}}; from a verb {{GHGheb|text=ל״ה}}, e.g. {{GHGheb|text=תִּקְוָה|translate=hope}}; (''c'') ''tăqṭĭl'', e.g. {{GHGheb|text=תַּשְׁבֵּץ|translate=chequer work}}; fem. {{GHGheb|text=תַּרְדֵּמָה|translate=deep sleep}} (probably from the {{GHGterm|Niphʿal}} {{GHGheb|text=נִרְדַּם}}); from a verb {{GHGheb|text=פ״ו}}, {{GHGheb|text=תּֽוֹכֵחָה|translate=correction}} (from the {{GHGterm|Hiphʿîl}}-stem, like the ''constr. st. plur.'' {{GHGheb|text=תּֽוֹלְדוֹת|translate=generations}}); from verbs {{GHGheb|text=ע״ע}}, {{GHGheb|text=תְּהִלָּה|translate=praise}}, {{GHGheb|text=תְּפִלָּה|translate=prayer}} (from the {{GHGterm|Piʿēl}} of the stems {{GHGheb|text=הָלַל}} and {{GHGheb|text=פָּלַל}}).
